Third party reporting boundaries

The current primary-record package does not establish a named officer’s ALPR misuse finding, termination reason, decertification request or final certification outcome. Request PDFOI-2026-3952 seeks underlying records; a request confirmation is not a misconduct finding.

Any external reporting must remain attributed and linked separately. Identity linkage, disciplinary reasons and certification outcomes need authentic agency or commission records. A request for decertification and a final commission decision describe different stages. No first-to-publish claim is established here.

Personal health information, dates of birth, addresses, witness details and unrelated incidents are outside this ALPR evidence library. Context screenshots are excluded from the package.

Primary records and ARAP interpretations are identified separately. Original record downloads require redaction review and approval.
